thread:
Maya (ACME): hey team — since this morning we're getting intermittent 403s on our product calls. embeddings sometimes fail, and generation calls return 403 about missing permissions. example curl attached below, happens ~1/20 requests.
Maya (ACME): curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk.xxx' \
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -d '{"model":"xlarge","input":"hi"}'
Maya (ACME): msg id: req-20240317-01, we can reproduce locally with our svc token.
Ravi (CS): thanks, Maya — sorry about the disruption. quick Qs: is this a newly provisioned key or one that rotated? any changes in your SSO/provisioner recently?
Maya (ACME): key was created by our onboarding script on Mar 10. No manual rotations since. We handed a list of scopes to the provisioning CSV (generated by our infra) — maybe that matters.
Ana (Provisioner): can you paste the decoded JWT claim for the token? specifically the `scope` claim.
Maya (ACME): sure — decoded payload: `{"sub":"svc-acme-12","scope":"embeddings;inference;rerank","iss":"sso.acme"}`
Eli (SRE): aha. note the scopes are semicolon-separated. our runtime auth parser historically accepts spaces or commas only. semicolon will produce a single literal scope `embeddings;inference;rerank` which won't match any granted perms -> 403. explains intermittent behaviour if some proxy rewrites or some tokens had commas.
Ravi (CS): good find. Maya — did your onboarding CSV use semicolons as delimiters?
Maya (ACME): yes, our ops team used a template that joined scopes with `;` — probably because their shell split uses `IFS=';'` in one script.
Ana (Provisioner): looks like our provisioner recently got a refactor (Mar 9) to simplify escaping — I suspect it normalized delimiters inconsistently. I'll audit.
Jason (Eng): tagging eng to triage: @Eli this is an auth parsing edgecase. runtime code currently does `scopes = claim.scope.split(/[,\s]+/)` (in one place) but the provisioning path that constructs JWT sometimes emits `;`. Fix: change split to `/[,;\s]+/` and add unit test for semicolon delim. Also add defensive logging when a scope contains `;` characters.
Eli (SRE): +1. quick patch we can roll as a hotfix to prod auth middleware. I'll prepare a PR with tests.
Ravi (CS): mitigation for ACME: please reprovision the key but join scopes with commas (e.g., `embeddings,inference,rerank`) — that should bypass the issue until we deploy. Also, if you can, rotate the key so new token has correct scope entries.
Maya (ACME): will do rotation now. thanks.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: auth-parser-hotfix -> staging (ci/2456) :eyes:
Jason (Eng): after hotfix lands, we'll run a small canary against known affected tenants (ACME + one internal test tenant). ETA to staging deploy: 20-30m, prod after verification.
Ana (Provisioner): I'll also add a linter in the provisioner to normalize delimiters to commas on write and in docs mention only `,` or space.
Ravi (CS): reopening ticket CS-4321 to track: owner Ravi, severity: high, customer impact: intermittent 403 on inference/embeddings/rerank. Please attach this thread.
Maya (ACME): rotation done, tests passing. we'll monitor and report if 403s reappear. really appreciate the quick turnaround :heart:
Jason (Eng): thanks — we'll keep you posted. once patch is live I'll post the release note and remediation summary. :shipit:
Eli (SRE): PR merged to staging, running canaries. will update CS-4321 with logs.
Ravi (CS): marking this as triaged -> engineering fix + provisioning hardening. followups: confirm hotfix in prod, add unit test to prevent regressions, update onboarding docs to call out delimiter rules.
Maya (ACME): thanks all!
